tasks.subject: Task 1: Format constants, string table, Variant/FSDataType codecs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The .fsb building blocks — format header, deduped string table, tagged Variant codec (external-resource table), FSDataType codec — round-trip in isolation.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_format.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*BytecodeCodec*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["header guard rejects mismatched engine build", "string table dedup", "resource constants become external refs with no property payload", "process-bound Variants rejected", "FSDataType round-trip"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Codegen fixup recording
tasks.description:
**Goal:** FSByteCodeGenerator records, under TOOLS_ENABLED, symbolic descriptors for every process-bound pointer it emits, plus {code_offset, global_name} pairs for OPCODE_STORE_GLOBAL, stored on the produced FSFunction.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_codegen.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_byte_codegen.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_byte_codegen.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_compiler.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["descriptor index == pointer-table index for all 12 tables", "STORE_GLOBAL offsets recorded with names", "full suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: FSFunction serialize/deserialize/link round-trip
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One compiled FSFunction round-trips through bytes and executes identically after linking, with hard errors on unresolvable fixups.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_function.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_byte_codegen.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*BytecodeFunction*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["execution parity with directly-compiled function", "hard error on unresolvable fixup", "release-subset payload only"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Whole-script graph serialization
tasks.description:
**Goal:** serialize(script) / load_skeleton + load_full round-trip a complete FoundryScript — inheritance, inner classes, members, signals, constants, static variables, lambdas, generics, traits/witnesses — into a runnable script.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_export.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/foundry_script.h", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-case=\"*BytecodeScript*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["full class-graph round-trip", "witness re-registration", "reload-tail ordering"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Fixture-corpus round-trip mode
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every runtime fixture in modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/ passes when executed through compile → serialize → deserialize → link → run, diffing the same .out files as the text path.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/tests/fs_test_runner.h", "modules/foundry_script/tests/fs_test_runner.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/fs_test_runner_suite.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["corpus parity in bytecode mode", "full suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: FSCache and resource-loader integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A .fsb file on disk loads end-to-end through ResourceLoader — shallow/full cache branches, dependencies, cycles, reload guard — with the engine-version guard enforced.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_cache.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/foundry_script.h", "modules/foundry_script/foundry_script.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ResourceLoader end-to-end", "cycles work", "reload guard", "version guard rejection"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Export preset mode and export plugin
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Selecting Compiled Bytecode in an export preset ships .fsb files (path-remapped like .fsc), fails the export on any compile error, and fails the export when a scene contains a built-in script.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["editor/export/editor_export_preset.h", "editor/export/editor_export_preset.cpp", "editor/export/project_export.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/register_types.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors && headless export of scratchpad test project", "acceptanceCriteria": ["enum appended", "PCK contains only .fsb", "compile error fails export", "built-in script fails export"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Hardening — verifier, corrupt inputs, leak assertions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A hostile or corrupted .fsb cannot crash the release VM, and a produced .fsb provably contains no source text or local identifiers.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_bytecode_loader.cpp", "modules/foundry_script/tests/test_bytecode_serialization.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/foundry.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["verifier bounds-checks all operands", "corruption never crashes", "no local-identifier/source leakage", "version pin"]}
```
